item: The 72 h run is counted from the lane's rows, so a crash or an update does not reset it (wiki_lane.run, Run so far, Stopped)
status: shipped (fixture-verified; awaiting the operator's 72 h run)
key_paths: src/wiki/counters.py; src/monitoring/soak_window.py; src/api/living.py; src/static/app-living.js; tests/test_wiki_counters.py; tests/living_sources_node_test.js; docs/USER_MANUAL.md
summary: Measured on main first: 36 random kill -9 moments and a v0.4.0 lane-file upgrade lose no stored data (integrity ok, nothing lost or duplicated, walk bookmark equal to its pages, stream resumed from the newest stored token); only the soak window's process-uptime clock and the offline boot restart. run_clock counts the hours in which this install stored or requested something (changes by recorded_at, size samples, walk hours with a request; never a change's occurred_at, so a replay after downtime cannot mark offline hours active), lists each stop (3 or more silent hours) and rides the soak-window lane block with reaches_bar; Living sources shows Run so far and a Stopped line. 0.65 s on 500k changes.
